title: OutcomeReport
description: The harness contract output (design §5, harness.OutcomeReport) and the body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/outcome. A stuck outcome always carries a stuckReason (R4).

failureReason.description: Ploeg's internal failure taxonomy (VIK-597), work.FailureReason. Normally set by the orchestrator; a harness adapter with structured evidence (e.g. an ACP stop reason) may classify its own failure, and the orchestrator's heuristics defer to it.

findings.description: a reading Run's contribution to the blackboard (ADR-0011): markdown prose Ploeg publishes to the pull request and injects into the next Round's briefing. Writers normally omit it.

usage.description: per-run cost/usage (backlog #66) and the harness-native resume handle (backlog #70)

verdict.description: a reading Run's answer to whether the work is done (ADR-0017). request_changes re-opens the plan's own writing Round, bounded by the Shift pool, maxFixRounds and the verdict itself. Ignored from a writing Role; it can name no Role, author no Round and raise no budget.
